claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.within_feet_of_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The activation gate depends on proximity to a placed magic item, which is not representable by the current holding/wearing/wielding predicate vocabulary.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemSpawnedCreatureMechanics item-rooted spawn placement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The summoned creature appears relative to the brazier rather than relative to the activator, but the current spawned-creature shape only exposes a coarse activator-rooted range header.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible...
